## 3. Proprietary Source Code & Client IP Transfer

* **Client Deliverables:** Upon complete settlement of the final 50% milestone escrow payment, **100% of all custom source code, repository commits, databases schemas, and bespoke UI assets transfer exclusively to the client**.
* **Zero Vendor Lock-In:** Clients receive unrestricted rights to host, modify, refactor, and commercialize their application with zero royalty obligations to BlazeByte Studio.
* **Agency Core Frameworks:** Reusable generic boilerplate libraries (such as base resets and utility helpers) are licensed under the standard **MIT License**.

* **RFC 9116:** Security contact disclosure (`.well-known/security.txt`) adheres to the open Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) RFC 9116 specification.
